description: M4 check script, seed 1, one player, peaceful: two workers pick the flint scatters west of the Big House while two chop pines to the north; the warrior hunts with N double-tapped (auto): it wears the deer north of the camp down with its spear, carries the meat home and goes again until dusk, then walks home; one flint picker moves on to the wild flax and the other prospects the ground east of the camp (Fair); Rations goes to troops only (the workers starve) and back to everyone, and eggs are kept back with Don't eat; the choppers put up a Scholar's Lodge south of the Big House and go back to chopping; at night the Big House makes a flint axe and knife (no research), then a sling and a fishing rod from the flax, and Equip Best hands the warrior the sling and a chopper the flint axe and knife. Building spots are columns (45 cm). Products: 8 + research, 64 + item.
